name: com.getminitools/minitools
title: MiniTools Precision Calculators
description: Free deterministic calculators: business days, mortgage, compound interest, VAT & Spain 2026.

tools.name: calculate_business_days
tools.description: Calculate exact business days between two calendar dates (excluding weekends and optional holidays) OR add/subtract business days to compute an exact deadline date.

mode.description: "between" counts business days between start_date and end_date; "add" adds/subtracts business_days from start_date.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required when mode="between").

business_days.description: Signed integer number of business days to add or subtract (required when mode="add").

include_end_date.description: Include end_date in the count when mode="between" (default false).

holidays.description: Optional list of custom holiday dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to exclude.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Compute exact monthly mortgage payment, total interest, total cost, payoff acceleration from extra monthly payments, and yearly amortization summary.

loan_amount.description: Property price or loan principal amount (> 0).

down_payment.description: Optional down payment subtracted from loan_amount (default 0).

annual_interest_rate_pct.description: Annual nominal interest rate in percent (e.g., 3.5 for 3.5%).

extra_monthly_payment.description: Optional extra principal paid each month (default 0).

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Calculate exact compound interest final balance, effective APY, total contributions, and growth milestones with optional monthly contributions.

annual_rate_pct.description: Annual nominal interest rate in percent (e.g., 7 for 7%).

tools.name: calculate_vat
tools.description: Add VAT to a net price or extract the exact net base and VAT amount from a VAT-inclusive gross price rounded cleanly to 2 decimal places.

vat_rate_pct.description: VAT/tax rate percentage (e.g., 21 for Spain, 20 for UK/France, 19 for Germany, 23 for Portugal).

mode.description: "add" adds VAT to a net amount; "remove" extracts net and VAT from a gross VAT-inclusive amount (default "add").

tools.name: calculate_spain_net_salary
tools.description: Calculate exact 2026 net salary in Spain across 12 or 14 payments with employee Social Security + MEI (capped at max contribution base), Art. 19/20 LIRPF deductions, personal/family allowances, and progressive IRPF bracket breakdown.

payments.description: Number of annual paychecks: 12 (prorated) or 14 (2 extra pays, default 14).

contract_type.description: Contract type for Social Security rate: "indefinite" (6.50%) or "temporary" (6.55%).

age_group.description: Taxpayer age bracket for personal allowance (default "under_65").

ss_max_base_annual_eur.description: Optional annual Social Security max contribution base cap in EUR (default 61214).

tools.name: calculate_spain_paro_sepe
tools.description: Calculate exact 2026 Spain SEPE contributory unemployment entitlement duration (4-24 months), 70%/60% monthly gross benefit, and official IPREM minimum/maximum caps adjusted by children and workday percentage.

regulatory_base_monthly_eur.description: Average monthly contribution base over the last 180 days in EUR.

contributed_days_last_6_years.description: Total contributed days over the last 6 years (minimum 360 for contributory benefit).

dependent_children.description: Number of dependent children (0, 1, or 2+ for IPREM cap tiers, default 0).
